question: Should QQBot reject inbound gateway messages above 1 MiB, or use a larger compatibility margin such as 16 MiB until Tencent documents an upper bound?
rationale: The dependency control and code location are correct, but neither the official QQ event contract nor current production evidence establishes 1 MiB as a safe permanent maximum.

options.title: Use 16 MiB
options.body: Retain a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while reducing the risk of disconnecting on an undocumented legitimate QQ event.

options.title: Keep 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the tighter boundary based on metadata-only event shapes and the submitted 900 KiB loopback proof.

options.title: Wait for QQ evidence
options.body: Measure authenticated production event sizes or obtain an authoritative Tencent limit before selecting the permanent ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Retain a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default while reducing the risk of disconnecting on an undocumented legitimate QQ event.
